name: none_empty_string
why: THE BIG ONE. Instruction.NONE is the empty string, and cue.py:53 reads `instruction in (Instruction.RIGHT)` -- a missing comma makes that a SUBSTRING test against 'R', and '' is a substring of everything. So every Start/End/Generic/Control row comes out GRAY. Almost certainly a typo; frozen because the output depends on it.

name: custom_r_substring
why: 'R' as a custom instruction is also a substring of 'R' -> GRAY.

name: custom_multi_char
why: 'QR' is NOT a substring of 'R' -> no colour.
